read.thesis: Tenet FY25 adj. EBITDA $4.57B (+14%) with margin 21.4%; 2026 guide $4.485–4.785B absorbs a $250M exchange-subsidy headwind, while supply-side signals are absent (capex $700–800M, no capacity cuts).

capex.quote: capital expenditures in the range of $700 million to $800 million

triggers.label: Hospital revenue per adj. admission +7.5% Q4
triggers.quote: revenue per adjusted admissions grew 7.5% year over year

triggers.label: 2026 exchange headwind $250M EBITDA
triggers.quote: We estimate that this represents a $250 million impact on our 2026 adjusted EBITDA

triggers.label: Hospital admissions flat in Q4
triggers.quote: Same-hospital inpatient adjusted admissions were flat

guidance.quote: consolidated adjusted EBITDA for 2026 in the range of $4.485 billion to $4.785 billion
We anticipate full-year adjusted EBITDA for USPI of $2.13 billion to $2.23 billion
we are expecting adjusted EBITDA in the range of $2.355 billion to $2.555 billion in 2026
resulting in adjusted free cash flows in the range of $2.5 billion to $2.8 billion
we are also assuming same-hospital admission growth of 1% to 2%
same-facility USPI revenue growth of 3% to 6% for 2026
our $250 million annual target for USPI M&A in 2026
